description: Defines the PdfEmbeddedFileStream class for handling embedded file streams in PDF documents, including initialization, property setting, and type checking.

classes.name: PdfEmbeddedFileStream
classes.description: Represents an embedded file stream within a PDF, providing initialization from a stream, type identification, and associated keys.

classes.name: PdfEmbeddedFileStream.Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for the embedded file stream dictionary, such as Type, Subtype, and Params.

methods.name: PdfEmbeddedFileStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the embedded file stream from a PDF document and a data stream.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dictionary elements and creates the PdfStream object.

methods.name: IsEmbeddedFile
methods.description: Checks if a given dictionary is an embedded file stream based on its type.
